question: Can triples be reliably extracted from source passages at the scale needed for training, and what is the typical noise level of such extractions?
description: Investigate the performance of open-domain triple extraction tools (e.g., OpenIE, parser-based) on text passages used for KGQA.
rationale: If extraction is too noisy, the context subgraph may introduce harmful noise; if reliable, the assumption holds.
resolution: No specific measurements of triple extraction noise at scale found in surveyed literature; extraction quality varies by tool and domain, and errors could introduce noise into context subgraphs.
